mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS "id", d.doc_no AS "docNo", d.kind AS "kind", d.biz_date AS "bizDate", d.total_qty AS "totalQty", d.total_amount AS "totalAmount", d.wms_doc_no AS "wmsDocNo" FROM scm_trade_doc d WHERE d.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY d.id

SELECT b.id AS "id", b.bill_no AS "billNo", b.kind AS "kind", b.source_no AS "sourceNo", b.bill_date AS "billDate", b.amount AS "amount", b.settled_amount AS "settledAmount", b.status AS "status", v.id AS "voucherId", v.voucher_no AS "voucherNo" FROM fin_bill b JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.id = b.source_id AND d.kind = b.source_type LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = b.voucher_id WHERE d.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY b.id

SELECT s.id AS "id", s.settle_no AS "settleNo", s.kind AS "kind", s.settle_date AS "settleDate", SUM(i.amount) AS "amount", s.status AS "status", v.id AS "voucherId", v.voucher_no AS "voucherNo" FROM fin_settlement_item i JOIN fin_settlement s ON s.id = i.settlement_id JOIN fin_bill b ON b.id = i.bill_id JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.id = b.source_id AND d.kind = b.source_type LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = s.voucher_id WHERE d.order_id = #{orderId} GROUP BY s.id, s.settle_no, s.kind, s.settle_date, s.status, v.id, v.voucher_no ORDER BY s.id

SELECT s.id AS "id", s.ship_no AS "shipNo", s.carrier AS "carrier", s.tracking_no AS "trackingNo", s.ship_date AS "shipDate", s.status AS "status", d.doc_no AS "tradeDocNo" FROM scm_shipment s JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.id = s.trade_doc_id WHERE d.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY s.id

SELECT q.id AS "id", q.insp_no AS "inspNo", q.source_no AS "sourceNo", m.code AS "materialCode", m.name AS "materialName", q.inspect_qty AS "inspectQty", q.result AS "result", q.status AS "status", q.inspect_date AS "inspectDate" FROM mes_inspection q JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.doc_no = q.source_no AND d.kind = 'PURCHASE_IN' JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = q.material_id WHERE q.type = 'IQC' AND d.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY q.id

SELECT p.id AS "id", p.plan_no AS "planNo", m.code AS "materialCode", m.name AS "materialName", p.qty AS "qty", p.due_date AS "dueDate", p.status AS "status", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_work_order w WHERE w.plan_id = p.id) AS "woCount", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(w.finished_qty), 0) FROM mes_work_order w WHERE w.plan_id = p.id) AS "finishedQty" FROM mes_plan p JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = p.material_id WHERE p.sales_order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY p.id
SELECT p.id AS "id", p.code AS "code", p.name AS "name", p.status AS "status", p.progress AS "progress" FROM pm_project p WHERE p.sales_order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY p.id
